summary: Splash Beverage Group filed an 8-K/A purely to correct a hyperlink to Exhibit 10.1 in its prior 8-K. The underlying agreement, an addendum to a CannEpil license, expands field of use to veterinary applications, adjusts royalties to 10% for veterinary and 15% for human net revenue, and extends deadlines. This is a routine license amendment, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, prices, or strategic restructuring are involved. The filing is administrative and correctional. Watch for product development momentum but no special-situation angle.
